text: A sharp burst of energy that kicks someone into motion, with a quick rising zip, medium in strength and over in half a second.
A crisp electric zap that rises fast and snaps forward, like a jolt of speed, short and punchy.
A quick charged zip of energy shooting upward, bright and tight, gone in an instant.
A faint, tight electric buzz, like a charged wire humming quickly, sitting low and steady under everything.
A thin, fast electrical hum of static energy, quiet and constant, even in volume throughout.
A soft, rapid crackling buzz of live current, low in volume, tight and steady.
